label: Map Route
description: Stylized dot-matrix flight map (world or US): a coarse land silhouette fades in as a radial dot stagger, then curved accent arcs draw between labeled endpoint markers with pulsing dots and uppercase label chips. Cast it for global reach, expansion, logistics, remote teams, or 'from X to Y' beats -- e.g. routes: [{"from":{"x":18,"y":34,"label":"San Francisco"},"to":{"x":48,"y":22,"label":"London"}}]. Coordinates are 0-100 percentages of the map box; 1-4 routes read best. Place over the whole stage or a large map region.

from.label: Origin: {x, y (0-100 % of map box), label}

to.label: Destination: {x, y (0-100 % of map box), label}

dot_color.label: Land dot color (default muted per theme)
